title: Scully says Dr. G is no longer available

tellings.quote: And Scully says, "Oh, that won't be possible. Uh, we uh what was the He's no longer available."

plain: In 1950, at a Chicago radio station, the journalist Frank Scully, who had written about crashed flying saucers, was asked about the unnamed scientist he called Dr. G and answered, "Oh, that won't be possible. He's no longer available." The researcher Scott Ramsey tells Michels this, without naming a source, and also names a physicist, John Torrance Tate, in connection with it. If true, it would mean Scully's key source had dropped out of sight just when people wanted to hear from him.
